Network

Character service integration

One asynchronous native adapter bridges zone validation and durable backend commands.

On this page
BoundaryRequest lifecycleBackend bootstrap orderProvider evaluation

Boundary

URPGCharacterServiceAdapter implements IRPGCharacterStore. The client frontend may call identity/roster/admission endpoints; zone-only mutation endpoints require service identity and current character epoch. All API_* pages are proposals to implement in GameService, not Blueprint HTTP nodes already present.

Request lifecycle

Create a typed request and correlation ID, attach authenticated identity through protected transport, validate response schema/version/status, and marshal completion to the game-thread owner. Check weak owner handle, request generation, CharacterId and epoch before applying a result.

On timeout keep the command pending/unknown and query API_CommandStatus. If the UI or pawn vanished after a successful commit, discard that observer callback; do not roll back the backend. A later snapshot loads the committed result. Canceling a local HTTP wait does not cancel a committed economy command.

Backend bootstrap order

Identity/characters/appearance plus idempotent creation first; next sessions/commands/ledger/item/stack/wallet base; then zone registry/transfers and gameplay endpoints by phase. Add foreign keys and constraints as each relation becomes active. Initial grants use unique entitlements so future login and migration do not repeat them.

Provider evaluation

Compare the actual selected account provider’s platform coverage, recovery, token validation, privacy requirements and engine integration. Keep the authenticator interface independent of durable character records. Document account recovery and soft deletion using verified provider behavior before public deployment; this package does not claim a password/auth service is running.

Evidence and external references

External links need internet; the manual itself remains offline. Public documentation does not prove installed compatibility.

  • Online Services — Public overview checked; provider capabilities and beta shipping limitations require provider/version-specific verification.
  • .NET support lifecycle — Official table checked: .NET 10 support runs to 2028-11-14/15 depending on display timezone. Patch version must be pinned locally.
  • PostgreSQL transaction isolation — Official current documentation resolved to PostgreSQL 18; transaction isolation and whole-transaction retry requirements checked.
